title: Send feedback and privacy
summary: Help > Send Feedback sends a bug report or suggestion when you press Send; usage metrics are opt-in and off by default.
alternateQueries: How do I report a bug?
How do I turn off metrics?

steps.instruction: Choose Bug report or Suggestion and write your message.

steps.expectedResult: The message is sent (the button shows Sending... meanwhile).

blocks.text: Feedback is anonymous by default: an install identifier, the app version and the operating system, never your files or content. Both sending written feedback and sharing anonymous usage metrics are opt-in and off by default.
